name: Lido
description: Liquid staking for Ethereum and Polygon. Daily staking rewards, no lock ups.

methodology.UserFees: Lido takes no fees from users.
methodology.Fees: Staking rewards earned by all ETH staked with Lido: consensus-layer validator rewards plus execution-layer rewards (priority fees and MEV), as booked by each daily oracle report.
methodology.Revenue: Lido takes a 10% fee on staking rewards; Revenue is only the DAO-treasury portion of that fee (net of the node-operator share, which is a cost of production booked as SupplySideRevenue). From Lido V2 (first report 2023-05-16) the treasury/operator split is the validator-share-weighted aggregate read from the StakingRouter at the oracle report's block; before V2 the split was a fixed 5%/5%, so half the fee is treasury. Rewards Share payouts to partners and Curated Module tier rebates, which the DAO pays out of its share through the Rewards Share Easy Track, are deducted on the day they are paid.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: DAO-treasury portion of the 10% fee, minus the Rewards Share payouts and Curated Module tier rebates paid from it and the LDO bought back under the LDO Accumulation Program; excludes the node-operator share.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Staking rewards earned by stETH holders, the node-operator share of the 10% fee (paid to operators for running validators), and the Rewards Share payouts and Curated Module tier rebates the DAO pays out of its share.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Tracks LIDO bought back by the DAO as part of the LDO Accumulation Program

hallmarks: Start of incentives for curve pool

Fees.Staking Rewards: ETH rewards from running Beacon chain validators (consensus-layer balance change plus withdrawals, net of principal), as booked by each oracle report.
Fees.MEV Rewards: Execution-layer rewards (priority fees and MEV tips paid by block builders) withdrawn from the Lido Execution Layer Rewards Vault at each oracle report.

Revenue.Staking Rewards: DAO treasury share of staking rewards. From Lido V2 (first report 2023-05-16) the ratio is read from StakingRouter.getStakingFeeAggregateDistributionE4Precision() at the oracle report block — treasuryFee / (modulesFee + treasuryFee); before V2 it is the fixed 5%/5% split (treasury share 0.5). Net of the Rewards Share payouts and tier rebates paid that day (see SupplySideRevenue), so negative on some payout days.
Revenue.MEV Rewards: DAO treasury share of MEV rewards.

ProtocolRevenue.DAO treasury share: DAO treasury share of the 10% fee on staking and MEV rewards, minus Rewards Share payouts and tier rebates and minus LDO bought back under the LDO Accumulation Program (negative on some payout and buyback days).

SupplySideRevenue.Staking rewards to ETH stakers: Share of ETH rewards from running Beacon chain validators to stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV rewards to ETH stakers: Share of ETH rewards from MEV tips on ETH execution layer paid by block builders to stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.Staking rewards to node operators: Share of ETH rewards from running Beacon chain validators to node operators.
SupplySideRevenue.MEV rewards to node operators: Share of ETH rewards from MEV tips on ETH execution layer paid by block builders to node operators.
SupplySideRevenue.Rewards Share payouts to partners: stETH the DAO pays Rewards Share partners whose referral code or router brings stake (up to 50% of the DAO share of rewards on that stake, https://research.lido.fi/t/11107/2), on the day of each Easy Track top-up through the Rewards Share registry. May include stVaults Rewards Share, which the chain does not mark.
SupplySideRevenue.Tier rebates to Curated Module operators: stETH the DAO pays Extra Effort, Decentralization and Public Good (client-team) Curated Module operators on top of the 3.5% module fee since the 2025-12-24 fee change, on the day it is paid.

HoldersRevenue.LDO Accumulation Program: Tracks LIDO bought back by the DAO.
